AVI Products India Ltd is an enterprise experiencing a severe and accelerating collapse in its top line, evidenced by a compounded sales growth of -4% over 10 years deteriorating sharply to -31% over 3 years and hitting -75% over the trailing twelve months [E13, E15, E16]. This catastrophic revenue contraction is further underscored by a recent screen reason of sales dropping -95% year-over-year [E64] alongside decelerating earnings growth [E65], compounding the official flag that five-year sales growth is a dismal -13.1% [E55] while the broader sector achieves a median sales growth of 11.7% [E71]. Compounding these fundamental operational failures, the company is deeply unprofitable, generating a devastating return on equity of -37.69% and a return on assets of -33.21%, both of which lag drastically behind their respective sector benchmarks of 4.7% and 1.55% [E7, E8]. Despite this total destruction of operational health and a negative P/E ratio of -9.96x [E5], irrational momentum has pushed the stock sitting 100% of the way up its 52-week range [E4] to trade at an unjustified price-to-book ratio of 3.20x to 3.36x, more than double the sector benchmark of 1.54x [E1, E6]. However, the bull's claim that this price reflects an agile operational turnaround driven by informed participants is entirely speculative and unbacked by the record, which instead shows a severe -75% collapse in trailing twelve-month sales and a staggering -95% year-on-year drop [E16, E64].
